supporting_observations.claim: At 14:00 UTC, nora.blake launched mstsc.exe to DC-NWD-01; DNS resolved the host to 10.40.20.10 and the workstation initiated a TCP connection to that address on port 3389.

The RDP attempt is inconsistent with the stated practice that remote administration is done only from WS-SOKAFOR-01. The available records show an attempt from WS-NBLAKE-01, but do not establish that the session succeeded or what occurred in it.

At 13:24 UTC, nora.blake ran ChromeSetup.exe --silent from her user Temp directory at medium integrity; the process later exited. These records do not establish whether it was legitimate or malicious.
The supplied records do not establish that ext.rwong was created, who created the account, or what groups or privileges it received.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records contain no domain-controller account-management event or other direct evidence of ext.rwong account creation.
The supplied records show an outbound RDP connection attempt from WS-NBLAKE-01, but include no DC-side logon/session result or activity.
The ChromeSetup process records provide no file signature, download source, installation result, or related network activity.
claims_not_established: Whether ext.rwong was actually created around 13:42 UTC, and the identity of the creator.

Whether nora.blake's RDP connection to DC-NWD-01 succeeded and, if so, what actions occurred.
Whether ChromeSetup.exe was authorized software or malicious.
Whether the account alert and the observed RDP activity are related.
additional_evidence_needed: Retrieve DC-NWD-01 security and directory audit events around 13:20–14:20 UTC, including account creation, group membership changes, and logon/session events; determine the creator identity and ext.rwong's resulting memberships and privileges.
Retrieve RDP/Terminal Services and relevant security logs from DC-NWD-01 to confirm whether the connection from WS-NBLAKE-01 succeeded and identify activity during any session.
Collect endpoint process, file reputation/signature, and network telemetry for ChromeSetup.exe on WS-NBLAKE-01.
